messages:
maya: quick async standup — renewal for CrescentIQ in 9 days. doing a focused surge on their onboarding errors. post W / Blockers / Today. if you need eng help ping @eng-oncall. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8420 :eyes:

jonathan: W: synced w/ CrescentIQ PM, they ramped import rate x3 yesterday. B: customers still see intermittent 500s on bulk import. Today: temp rate-limit change applied to tenant, will validate and gather traces.

eli: W: ran canary of the retry-fix on dedicated yesterday (10% traffic). saw error rate drop from 6% -> 2.3%. B: couldn't reproduce full stack trace in staging (different seq lengths). Today: prepping PR with extra KV-cache guards, adding more debug logs.

maya: thanks eli — can you paste the canary results summary here when you have it? also CS team asked for rollback plan if patch makes things worse.

eli: sure — summary: 12h window, 1.3k requests, errors 28 -> 8. attached small log excerpt below:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z ERROR import_handler: downstream 500, kvcache_miss=true, seq_len=2048
2026-03-18T09:12:07Z INFO  retry-schedule: attempt=2 tenant=crescentiq
```

sophie: W: reviewed eli's PR, left two nits about variable names and an unclear test. B: need maintainers sign-off on the compile flags for quantized kernels. Today: I'll do a follow-up review after noon.

jonathan: quick note — CS wants an ETA on when we can tell CrescentIQ the root cause. can we aim for a brief writeup by EOD?

maya: yes. EOD summary would be great. please include: what we changed (rate limit + canary patch), impact numbers, and rollback steps.

eng-oncall: saw the canary metrics in observability. flagged a potential secondary regression on latencies for seq_len>3k when cache-miss rate is high — opened an incident placeholder to track: INC-5673. tagging eng-runtime.

eli: noted. i'll add a latency breakdown to the PR description and a small benchmark.

cs-bot: automated: created internal follow-up CS-8420 (linked). Reminder: set renewal outreach touchpoint after issue stabilizes.

maya: Blockers roundup: 1) eng review for PR (sophie) 2) trace from production for two failed imports (jonathan) 3) confirm rollback procedure (maya/ops). If anyone is blocked on reviews, drop a :pray: or DM.

sophie: can review after lunch. not blocked otherwise.

jonathan: trace collection in progress, ETA ~2hrs.

eli: will push updated PR by +3hrs with logs and benchmark notes.

maya: perfect. i'll draft the EOD summary once jonathan uploads traces. thank you — keep updates short here and we can close the thread when EOD note is posted. :thumbsup:
